G800.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «4859»; inharmonious (figuratively):--agree not.

G801.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «4908»; unintelligent; by implication, wicked:--foolish, without understanding.

G802.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (4934)
G802.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «4934»; properly, not agreed, i.e. treacherous to compacts:-- covenant-breaker.

G804.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and sphallo (to "fail")
G804.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and sphallo (to "fail"); secure (literally or figuratively):--certain(-ty), safe, sure.

G806.def: adverb from «804»; securely (literally or figuratively):--assuredly, safely.

G807.def: from «809»; to be (i.e. act) unbecoming:--behave self uncomely (unseemly).

G808.def: from «809»; an indecency; by implication, the pudenda:--shame, that which is unseemly.

G809.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (2192) (in the sense of its congener (4976))
G809.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «2192» (in the sense of its congener «4976»); properly, shapeless, i.e. (figuratively) inelegant:--uncomely.

G810.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (4982)
G810.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «4982»; properly, unsavedness, i.e. (by implication) profligacy:--excess, riot.

G811.def: adverb from the same as «810»; dissolutely:--riotous.

G812.def: from «813»; to be (i.e. act) irregular:--behave self disorderly.

G813.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (5021)
G813.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «5021»; unarranged, i.e. (by implication) insubordinate (religiously):--unruly.

G815.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5043»; childless:--childless, without children.

G816.et: from a compound of (1) (as a particle of union) and teino (to stretch)
G816.def: from a compound of «1» (as a particle of union) and teino (to stretch); to gaze intently:--behold earnestly (stedfastly), fasten (eyes), look (earnestly, stedfastly, up stedfastly), set eyes.

G817.def: a particle probably akin to «427»; aloof, i.e. apart from (literally or figuratively):--in the absence of, without.

G818.def: from «820»; to render infamous, i.e. (by implication) contemn or maltreat:--despise, dishonour, suffer shame, entreat shamefully.

G819.def: from «820»; infamy, i.e. (subjectively) comparative indignity, (objectively) disgrace:--dishonour, reproach, shame, vile.

G820.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5092»; (negatively) unhonoured or (positively) dishonoured:--despised, without honour, less honourable (comparative degree).

G821.def: from «820»; used like «818», to maltreat:--handle shamefully.

G823.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and the base of (5114)
G823.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and the base of «5114»; uncut, i.e. (by implication) indivisible (an "atom" of time):-- moment.

G824.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5117»; out of place, i.e. (figuratively) improper, injurious, wicked:--amiss, harm, unreasonable.

G825.def: from Attalos (a king of Pergamus); Attaleia, a place in Pamphylia:--Attalia.

G827.def: of uncertain derivation; a ray of light, i.e. (by implication) radiance, dawn:--break of day.

G828.def: from Latin ("august"); Augustus, a title of the Roman emperor:--Augustus.

G829.def: from «846» and the base of «2237»; self-pleasing, i.e. arrogant:--self-willed.

G830.def: from «846» and the same as «140»; self-chosen, i.e. (by implication) voluntary:--of own accord, willing of self.

G831.et: from a compound of (846) and an obsolete hentes (a worker)
G831.def: from a compound of «846» and an obsolete hentes (a worker); to act of oneself, i.e. (figuratively) dominate:--usurp authority over.

G833.def: from the same as «109»; a yard (as open to the wind); by implication, a mansion:--court, (sheep-)fold, hall, palace.

G835.def: middle voice from «833»; to pass the night (properly, in the open air):--abide, lodge.

G836.def: from the same as «109»; a flute (as blown):--pipe.

G837.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb
G837.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to grow ("wax"), i.e. enlarge (literal or figurative, active or passive):--grow (up), (give the) increase.

G839.et: from a derivative of the same as (109) (meaning a breeze, i.e. the morning air)
G839.def: from a derivative of the same as «109» (meaning a breeze, i.e. the morning air); properly, fresh, i.e. (adverb with ellipsis of «2250») to-morrow:--(to-)morrow, next day.

G840.et: from a (presumed) derivative of the same as (109) (meaning blown)
G840.def: from a (presumed) derivative of the same as «109» (meaning blown); rough (properly as a gale), i.e. (figuratively) severe:--austere.

G841.def: from «842»; self-satisfaction, i.e. (abstractly) contentedness, or (concretely) a competence:--contentment, sufficiency.

G843.def: from «846» and a derivative or «2632»; self-condemned:--condemned of self.

G844.def: from «846» and the same as «3155»; self-moved ("automatic"), i.e. spontaneous:--of own accord, of self.

G845.def: from «846» and «3700»; self-seeing, i.e. an eye-witness:--eye-witness.

G846.pos:
1. himself, herself, themselves, itself
  2. he, she, it
  3. the same
G846.et: from the particle au [perhaps akin to the base of (109) through the idea of a baffling wind] (backward)
G846.def: from the particle au (perhaps akin to the base of «109» through the idea of a baffling wind) (backward); the reflexive pronoun self, used (alone or in the comparative «1438») of the third person , and (with the proper personal pronoun) of the other persons:--her, it(-self), one, the other, (mine) own, said, (self-), the) same, ((him-, my-, thy- )self, (your-)selves, she, that, their(-s), them(-selves), there(-at, - by, -in, -into, -of, -on, -with), they, (these) things, this (man), those, together, very, which. Compare «848».

G847.et: genitive (i.e. possessive) of (846), used as an adverb of location
G847.def: genitive (i.e. possessive) of «846», used as an adverb of location; properly, belonging to the same spot, i.e. in this (or that) place:--(t-)here.

G848.def: contracted for «1438»; self (in some oblique case or reflexively, relation):--her (own), (of) him(-self), his (own), of it, thee, their (own), them(-selves), they.

G849.def: from «846» and 5495; self-handed, i.e. doing personally:--with ... own hands.

G850.et: from auchmos [probably from a base akin to that of (109)] (dust, as dried by wind)
G850.def: from auchmos (probably from a base akin to that of «109») (dust, as dried by wind); properly, dirty, i.e. (by implication) obscure:--dark.

G851.def: from «575» and «138»; to remove (literally or figuratively):--cut (smite) off, take away.

G852.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5316»; non-apparent):--that is not manifest.

G853.def: from «852»; to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed):-- corrupt, disfigure, perish, vanish away.

G855.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (5316)
G855.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «5316»; non-manifested, i.e. invisible:--vanished out of sight.

G856.et: from a compound of (575) and the base of (1476)
G856.def: from a compound of «575» and the base of «1476»; a place of sitting apart, i.e. a privy:--draught.

G857.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and (5339)
G857.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and «5339»; unsparingness, i.e. austerity (asceticism):--neglecting.

G858.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and phellos (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot)
G858.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and phellos (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot); smoothness, i.e. (figuratively) simplicity:--singleness.

G859.def: from «863»; freedom; (figuratively) pardon:--deliverance, forgiveness, liberty, remission.

G861.def: from «862»; incorruptibility; genitive, unending existence; (figuratively) genuineness:--immortality, incorruption, sincerity.

G862.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (5351)
G862.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «5351»; undecaying (in essence or continuance):--not (in-, un-)corruptible, immortal.

G863.et: from (575) and hiemi (to send, an intens. form of eimi, to go)
G863.def: from «575» and hiemi (to send; an intensive form of eimi, to go); to send forth, in various applications (as follow):--cry, forgive, forsake, lay aside, leave, let (alone, be, go, have), omit, put (send) away, remit, suffer, yield up.

G864.def: from «575» and the base of «2425»; to go (i.e. spread) forth (by rumor):--come abroad.

G865.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5358»; hostile to virtue:--despiser of those that are good.

G866.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5366»; unavaricious:--without covetousness, not greedy of filthy lucre.

G867.def: from «864»; properly, arrival, i.e. (by implication) departure:--departing.

G868.def: from «575» and «2476»; to remove, i.e. (actively) instigate to revolt; usually (reflexively) to desist, desert, etc.:--depart, draw (fall) away, refrain, withdraw self.

G870.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and (5401)
G870.def: adverb from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and «5401»; fearlessly:--without fear.

G871.def: from «575» and «3666»; to assimilate closely:--make like.

G873.def: from «575» and «3724»; to set off by boundary, i.e. (figuratively) limit, exclude, appoint, etc.:--divide, separate, sever.

G874.def: from a compound of «575» and «3729»; a starting-point, i.e. (figuratively) an opportunity:--occasion.

G875.def: from «876»; to froth at the mouth (in epilepsy):--foam.

G876.def: apparently a primary word; froth, i.e. slaver:--foaming.

G877.def: from «878»; senselessness, i.e. (euphemistically) egotism; (morally) recklessness:--folly, foolishly(-ness).

G878.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5424»; properly, mindless, i.e. stupid, (by implication) ignorant, (specially) egotistic, (practically) rash, or (morally) unbelieving:--fool(-ish), unwise.

G879.def: from a compound of «575» and «5258»; properly, to become awake, i.e. (by implication) to drop (off) in slumber:--fall asleep.

G880.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5456»; voiceless, i.e. mute (by nature or choice); figuratively, unmeaning:--dumb, without signification.

G881.def: of Hebrew origin («0271»); Achaz, an Israelite:--Achaz.

G882.def: of uncertain derivation; Achaia (i.e. Greece), a country of Europe:--Achaia.

G883.def: from «882»; an Achaian; Achaicus, a Christian:--Achaicus.

G884.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (5483)
G884.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «5483»; thankless, i.e. ungrateful:--unthankful.

G885.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare «03137»); Achim, an Israelite:--Achim.

G886.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5499»; unmanufactured, i.e. inartificial:--made without (not made with) hands.

G887.def: of uncertain derivation; dimness of sight, i.e. (probably) a cataract:--mist.

G888.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (5534) [cf (5532)]
G888.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «5534» (compare «5532»); useless, i.e. (euphemistically) unmeritorious:--unprofitable.

G889.def: from «888»; to render useless, i.e. spoil:--become unprofitable.

G890.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5543»; inefficient, i.e. (by implication) detrimental:--unprofitable.

G891.et: akin to (206) (through the idea of a terminus)
G891.def: or achris akh'-rece; akin to «206» (through the idea of a terminus); (of time) until or (of place) up to:--as far as, for, in(-to), till, (even, un-)to, until, while. Compare «3360».

G892.et: perhaps remotely from cheo (to shed forth)
G892.def: perhaps remotely from cheo (to shed forth); chaff (as diffusive):--chaff.

G893.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5579»; veracious:--that cannot lie.

G894.def: of uncertain derivation; wormwood (as a type of bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) calamity):--wormwood.

G895.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5590»; lifeless, i.e. inanimate (mechanical):--without life.

G896.def: of Hebrew origin («01168»); Baal, a Phoenician deity (used as a symbol of idolatry):--Baal.

G897.def: of Hebrew origin («0894»); Babylon, the capitol of Chaldaea (literally or figuratively (as a type of tyranny)):-- Babylon.

G898.def: from the same as «899»; a step, i.e. (figuratively) grade (of dignity):--degree.

G899.def: from the same as «901»; profundity, i.e. (by implication) extent; (figuratively) mystery:--deep(-ness, things), depth.
